column3: Retains the people rather than the men.
Retains Israel being joined to Baal-Peor and repeats Israel.
The Hebrew says “before the sun” and explicitly names the LORD in “the burning anger of the LORD”; BSB says “in broad daylight” and “His fierce anger.”
Does not add all or explicitly specify worshiping.
Retains his brothers and repeats before the eyes.
Retains being zealous with My zeal.
Repeats the man being struck and retains the collective singular Simeonite.
Retains the present they are opposing you, the repeated matter of, and the repeated matter of Peor.
